title: Fresno, California: Understanding Uninsured Hit-and-Run Accidents
metaDescription: Learn about uninsured hit-and-run accidents in Fresno, CA, including statistics, legal implications, and how WreckMatch can help you navigate these situations.
excerpt: Educational Fresno, CA guide — 2-year SOL, local hospitals, and insurer tactics. Not legal advice.

sections.heading: Confirm coverage at the scene
paragraphs: Ask for insurance card photos and verify policy status. In Fresno, uninsured motorist rates track with statewide averages — always assume minimum limits until verified.

sections.heading: Your UM/UIM policy in California
paragraphs: Uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage on your policy may pay when the at-fault driver has no coverage or insufficient 30/60/15 limits.
Notify your carrier promptly; UM claims still require documentation of injuries and damages.

sections.heading: Hit-and-run steps in Fresno
paragraphs: Report hit-and-runs immediately to Fresno police. UM coverage often requires a police report within 24–72 hours.
Seek witnesses and camera footage near Fresno downtown interchange.

sections.heading: Medical and financial documentation
paragraphs: Use Fresno Regional Medical Center if injured. Track lost wages and transportation costs.

sections.heading: When litigation may be necessary
paragraphs: If UM/UIM carriers deny or lowball offers, a licensed California attorney can evaluate bad-faith and negligence claims against the at-fault driver directly.

sections.heading: Fresno medical resources after a crash
paragraphs: Fresno residents often use Fresno Regional Medical Center, Fresno General Hospital after serious collisions. Level I trauma care is available at Fresno Level I Trauma Center.
Document every provider visit — gaps in treatment are a common reason CA insurers reduce settlement offers.
Keep receipts for prescriptions, imaging (MRI/CT), physical therapy, and medical transport.
list: Photograph visible injuries the same day when safe
Follow discharge instructions and keep all after-visit summaries
Do not sign blanket medical authorizations for the adjuster

The Fresno Bar Association offers lawyer-referral resources; WreckMatch LLC can also connect you with independent California attorneys at no obligation.

sections.heading: Settlement timeline expectations in Fresno
paragraphs: Minor property-damage claims in Fresno may resolve in weeks, but injury claims involving treatment, lost wages, or disputed fault often take months. Insurers may request recorded statements, independent medical exams, and broad medical authorizations — review each request carefully.
California uses Pure comparative comparative negligence with a 2-year statute of limitations for most injury cases. Calendar your deadline from the date of injury.
If you were transported from I-95 to Fresno Regional Medical Center, keep ambulance, ER, and follow-up bills organized. UM/UIM and MedPay endorsements may apply when the other driver is underinsured.
list: Do not accept the first settlement check if treatment is ongoing
Avoid discussing fault on social media
Request adjuster denials or reservations of rights in writing
Compare repair estimates with your insurer's appraisal
Consult a licensed attorney before signing general releases

sections.heading: Document checklist for Fresno claims
paragraphs: Organize a folder (physical or digital) for every document tied to your Fresno crash: police report number, insurance claim numbers, tow and storage receipts, and rental car agreements.
Request itemized medical bills from Fresno Regional Medical Center rather than summary statements — itemized bills help catch billing errors and support future negotiations.
list: Photos of all vehicles and the scene from multiple angles
Employer note for any missed work shifts
Insurance adjuster name, phone, and claim number
Repair estimates from at least two body shops
